Orders.expression:
VAR SellerOrders = VALUES(bridge_order_seller[order_id])
VAR CategoryOrders = VALUES(bridge_order_category[order_id])

 (NOT ISFILTERED(dim_category) || fact_order[order_id] IN CategoryOrders))

Wilson Lower.expression:
VAR N=[Eligible]
VAR P=[On Time Rate]
VAR Z=1.95996398454
VAR Den=1+DIVIDE(Z*Z,N)
VAR Mid=DIVIDE(P+DIVIDE(Z*Z,2*N),Den)
VAR Half=DIVIDE(Z*SQRT(DIVIDE(P*(1-P),N)+DIVIDE(Z*Z,4*N*N)),Den)
RETURN IF(N>0,Mid - Half)
Wilson Lower.description: 95% binomial Wilson interval; not selection-bias protection.

Wilson Upper.expression:
VAR N=[Eligible]
VAR P=[On Time Rate]
VAR Z=1.95996398454
VAR Den=1+DIVIDE(Z*Z,N)
VAR Mid=DIVIDE(P+DIVIDE(Z*Z,2*N),Den)
VAR Half=DIVIDE(Z*SQRT(DIVIDE(P*(1-P),N)+DIVIDE(Z*Z,4*N*N)),Den)
RETURN IF(N>0,Mid + Half)
Wilson Upper.description: 95% binomial Wilson interval; not selection-bias protection.

Region Baseline Late Rate.description: Retains slicers, removes region row context.

Region Pareto Cumulative.description: Sort Late descending; ties share endpoint.

Action Flag.expression: IF([Eligible]>=30 && [Late Rate]>[Region Baseline Late Rate],"Investigate dispatch and promise calibration","Monitor")
Action Flag.description: Sort Total Late Days descending; owner Regional operations lead.
